description: Get behavioural intelligence for one developer by GitHub username — how they actually work, not just their bio. Returns work pattern (chronotype, peak hours, work rhythm, activity trend, velocity change), collaboration style (solo vs team, external PR ratio, reviews given), professionalism signals (commit quality, conventional commits, primary work type), and activity recency. Flat 1 credit per successful lookup; a username not yet in Revternal's index answers 404. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_developer_intel({ github_username: "torvalds", _apiKey: "..." }).

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.
